senses.sense_definition: The branch of pharmacology that studies how the body affects a drug through absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion.

examples.text: The <w>pharmacokinetics</w> of this new medication are being studied to determine the safest dosage for patients.

target_lang_translations.zh: 研究人员正在研究这种新药的<w>药物动力学</w>，以确定患者最安全的用药剂量。

examples.text: Students in the medical program must understand <w>pharmacokinetics</w> to predict how different drugs will interact with the human body.

target_lang_translations.zh: 医学专业的学生必须理解<w>药物动力学</w>，才能预测不同药物与人体之间的相互作用。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 药理学的一个分支，研究机体对药物的吸收、分布、代谢和排泄过程。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指研究药物在生物体内吸收、分布、代谢和排泄规律的学科。

senses.sense_definition: The specific processes and rates by which a particular drug is absorbed, distributed, metabolized, and eliminated by an organism.

examples.text: The <w>pharmacokinetics</w> of the drug changed significantly when the patient started taking other medications.

target_lang_translations.zh: 当患者开始服用其他药物时，该药物的<w>药代动力学特征</w>发生了显著变化。

examples.text: Researchers analyzed the <w>pharmacokinetics</w> to ensure the drug remains in the bloodstream long enough to be effective.

target_lang_translations.zh: 研究人员分析了<w>药代动力学特征</w>，以确保药物在血液中停留足够长的时间从而发挥疗效。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 特定药物在生物体内被吸收、分布、代谢和消除的具体过程及速率。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指特定药物在体内的具体代谢过程和速率表现。
